articles.title: eMudhra Certificate Authority Compromise Triggers Emergency Action Across Browsers
articles.summary:
The private keys behind eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authority certificates have been compromised, prompting emergency blocks across major browsers and software platforms. The affected certificates chain to roots trusted by Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple, and Chrome, placing clients that still accept them at risk of trusting forged certificates. articles.title: Google Cloud Outage Knocks UK Banks, Websites and Court Systems Offline
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Open Banking Services to Test Stolen Credentials Without Paying a Cent
articles.summary:
Criminals have found a way to use open banking as a low-cost checking service for stolen bank and card details. In a campaign described by Group-IB, fraudsters abused a spend-management platform’s account-linking process to check whether credentials worked and whether linked accounts held funds. articles.title: WP2Shell Attack Lets Hackers Create WordPress Admin Accounts and Install Web Shells Without Login
articles.summary:
WP2Shell combines two WordPress Core flaws to move from an unauthenticated request to server-side code execution. It can let an attacker create an administrator account and install a plugin-based web shell. Seqrite’s October 16 analysis lists affected releases, but does not establish widespread live exploitation. The report says the flaws were disclosed in July 2026. […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Thousands of Android Phones Ship With Hidden Malware That Disables Google Play Protections
articles.summary:
